root.name: チョイス・ホテルズ・インターナショナル

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: ヒルトン・グランド・バケーションズ

relations.text: Bluegreen買収で、Choiceとの独占的な戦略提携を引き継いだ
relations.text_en: Took over an exclusive strategic relationship with Choice through the Bluegreen deal

source.label: Hilton Grand Vacations 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We also assumed an exclusive strategic relationship with Choice Hotels that involves several areas of its business, including a sales and marketing alliance

companies.name: ウィンダム・ホテルズ&リゾーツ

relations.text: 2023年に買収を目指し、関連して1.124億ドルの株式を取得
relations.text_en: Pursued an acquisition in 2023, buying $112.4 million of equity securities

source.label: Choice Hotels 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Company purchased $112.4 million of equity securities in conjunction with the Wyndham acquisition pursuit

relations.text: Holiday Inn・Holiday Inn Expressが主な競合ブランド
relations.text_en: Its Holiday Inn and Holiday Inn Express are principal competitor brands

source.label: Choice Hotels 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The principal competitor brands include Hampton by Hilton, Holiday Inn Express, and Fairfield by Marriott.

relations.text: Best Westernが主な競合ブランド
relations.text_en: Best Western is a principal competitor brand

source.label: Choice Hotels 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The principal competitor brands include Best Western and Wingate.

companies.name: マリオット・インターナショナル

relations.text: Marriottが10-Kで、競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Marriott names Choice Hotels among competitors

source.label: Marriott 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: including Hilton, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Hyatt, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, Accor, Choice Hotels, Best Western Hotels & Resorts, and others.

relations.text: Hiltonが10-Kで、世界的な主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Hilton names Choice Hotels among its primary global competitors

source.label: Hilton 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: our primary competitors are Accor S.A., Choice Hotels International, Hyatt Hotels Corporation, Intercontinental Hotel Group, Marriott International and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
